sources.entry: Mautic - Marketing automation software (email, social and more). (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Mautic is an open source marketing automation platform, self-hostable and written in PHP, for running multi-channel email and campaign workflows.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Mautic as open source marketing automation software aimed at businesses and organizations that want to run their own campaigns rather than rely on SaaS tools. It states it offers multi-channel marketing, unlimited segmentation and automation, and customizable frontend and backend. Users can keep their own database and control their data. Installation is documented via Composer (recommended for production), a DDEV-based setup, or a zip download followed by the web installer. The README also points to a hosted trial option, release pages, and community forums, GitHub issues, and developer/API documentation. Most of the README is a contributor list and links, with little detail on specific features.
use_cases: replacing SaaS marketing tools with an owned system
how_to_run: Run 'ddev config' followed by 'ddev start' if using DDEV
Or download the repository zip and extract it to your web root
Run 'composer install' in the project directory
Open your browser and complete the web installer
For production, the README recommends installing with Composer or using the pre-packaged Mautic from mautic.org/download
notable: Self-hosted, with the user owning their database and data
Source code is open under GPL-3.0 with no feature limits stated
Frontend and backend are described as fully customizable
Offers a hosted trial as well as self-hosting
caveats: The README warns that source installs from GitHub need command-line comfort and can drift out of sync with releases, so production use is recommended via Composer or the packaged download
Source code outside a tagged release is described as alpha and not recommended for production
Installation requires Composer to be available
